config.label: Comma-separated toolsets to expose: discovery, messages, channels, permissions, members, roles, moderation, screening, stats, forums, webhooks, scheduled_events, invites, dm, or all
config.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose: discovery, messages, channels, permissions, members, roles, moderation, screening, stats, forums, webhooks, scheduled_events, invites, dm, or all. An unknown name stops the server at startup.

config.label: Set to true to expose only the read-only tools of the selected toolsets: write tools are neither listed nor callable
config.description: Set to true to expose only the read-only tools of the selected toolsets: write tools are neither listed nor callable. Any value other than true/false, 1/0, yes/no or on/off stops the server at startup.

config.label: Comma-separated guild IDs the server may act on
config.description: Comma-separated guild IDs the server may act on. Calls that target any other guild are rejected. Unset allows every guild.

config.label: Set to false to stop requesting the Message Content privileged intent at connect time
config.description: Set to false to stop requesting the Message Content privileged intent at connect time.

config.label: Set to false to stop requesting the Server Members privileged intent at connect time
config.description: Set to false to stop requesting the Server Members privileged intent at connect time.

config.label: stdio, or http to serve Streamable HTTP on /mcp for remote clients such as the OpenAI Responses API, Codex or n8n
config.description: stdio, or http to serve Streamable HTTP on /mcp for remote clients such as the OpenAI Responses API, Codex or n8n. Any other value stops the server at startup.

config.label: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry
config.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required when DISCORD_MCP_TRANSPORT is http: at least 32 characters from the RFC 6750 b64token alphabet, different from DISCORD_TOKEN. Generate one with openssl rand -hex 32.

config.label: Address the HTTP server listens on when DISCORD_MCP_TRANSPORT is http
config.description: Address the HTTP server listens on when DISCORD_MCP_TRANSPORT is http. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless the server runs in a container.

config.label: Port the HTTP server listens on when DISCORD_MCP_TRANSPORT is http
config.description: Port the HTTP server listens on when DISCORD_MCP_TRANSPORT is http.

config.label: Comma-separated hostnames, without port, accepted in the Host header of HTTP requests besides localhost, 127
config.description: Comma-separated hostnames, without port, accepted in the Host header of HTTP requests besides localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1], such as the public name a reverse proxy forwards.
